_notes: ZeRO-3 shards weights+grads+optimizer across the 3 fabric nodes. offload=none on purpose: GB10 is UNIFIED memory (CPU+GPU share one 121GB pool) so CPU-offload adds NO capacity, it only burns Grace cores. stage3_gather_16bit_weights_on_model_save=true makes Trainer.save_model() write a normal consolidated HF checkpoint that eran4/vLLM can load directly. If GPU-allocator fragmentation ever OOMs at ~14B (it should not), toggle offload_optimizer.device to 'cpu' — same RAM, less allocator churn.
